description: Use when Today WP itself got something wrong: an answer, page or fact that looked wrong, outdated, missing or confusing, or an idea. One short note. To rate a plugin or doc, use wp_report. category: wrong (A fact that is not true.), outdated (True once, not anymore.), missing (Something an agent needed and did not get.), confusing (Hard to act on, ambiguous or misleading.), broken (A tool error, a dead link, a timeout.), idea (Something that would make answers better.). about: one of "A tool answer", "A plugin or page builder", "A doc or guide", "A news item", "This site", "Today WP itself". Never include the site address, prompts or code.

item.description: A tool name, slug or path it is about
